panels.title: BTC OHLC — Last 6 Hours
panels.description: One-minute BTC open/close range for short-term price direction.

targets.rawSql: SELECT window_start AS time, price_open AS open, GREATEST(price_open, price_close) AS high, LEAST(price_open, price_close) AS low, price_close AS close FROM gold_minute_volume WHERE symbol = 'BTCUSDT' AND $__timeFilter(window_start) ORDER BY window_start ASC

panels.title: Price Momentum — All Symbols (Last 30 Minutes)
panels.description: Minute price change above zero indicates positive momentum; below zero indicates negative momentum.

targets.rawSql: SELECT window_start AS time, symbol AS metric, price_change_pct AS value FROM gold_minute_volume WHERE window_start >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 minutes' ORDER BY window_start ASC

panels.title: Buy Pressure % — All Symbols (Last 6 Hours)
panels.description: Buyer-initiated volume share normalized to percent, making sentiment comparable across assets.

targets.rawSql: SELECT window_start AS time, symbol AS metric, ROUND((buy_volume / NULLIF(base_volume, 0) * 100)::numeric, 1) AS value FROM gold_minute_volume WHERE $__timeFilter(window_start) ORDER BY window_start ASC

panels.title: BTC VWAP Divergence % — Last 6 Hours
panels.description: VWAP above close suggests late-window selling pressure; VWAP below close suggests late-window buying pressure.

targets.rawSql: SELECT window_start AS time, ROUND(((minute_vwap - price_close) / NULLIF(price_close, 0) * 100)::numeric, 4) AS value FROM gold_minute_volume WHERE symbol = 'BTCUSDT' AND $__timeFilter(window_start) ORDER BY window_start ASC

panels.title: USD Notional Volume by Symbol — Last 6 Hours
panels.description: Comparable liquidity ranking using USD notional instead of non-comparable token units.

targets.rawSql: SELECT symbol AS metric, ROUND(SUM(quote_volume_usdt)::numeric, 0) AS value FROM gold_minute_volume WHERE $__timeFilter(window_start) GROUP BY symbol ORDER BY value DESC

panels.title: BNB Minute VWAP — Last 6 Hours
panels.description: Shorter history: BNB stream was added after BTC, ETH and SOL.

targets.rawSql: SELECT window_start AS time, minute_vwap AS value FROM gold_minute_volume WHERE symbol = 'BNBUSDT' AND $__timeFilter(window_start) ORDER BY window_start ASC
